about: A unit is placed at the top level of its template; its own if decides it (chapter 5 § 5.2.6; this implementation's sentence). The note places the snippet tone. Invalid: inside an if on the plan's state. Valid: at the top level.
sentences: Deliverable 'note' places snippet.tone.content at line 3 inside an if; a part, a snippet or a macro is placed at the top level of its template, and its own if decides it.
